P5 WHAT THE MAP CANNOT DO
It cannot run a cell. Nine descriptive layers plus one unreplicated timing relation
is a description, and no combination of the loops in this arc turns it into a
simulation.
It cannot be quoted as one system. K562 for the enhancer arc, A549 for timing, mixed
lines for the network, and nothing in this project has ever measured two of those
layers in the same cells at the same time.
P3 is one dataset, one drug, one split. A pass would show the map can step forward
HERE, not that it generalises; a fail leaves open that a different feature set would
do better, and neither reading is settled by one ridge regression.
Every trajectory is bulk. A fast response in a fifth of the cells and a slow one
everywhere give the same curve, and nothing in this arc can separate them.
The capability table lists what was MEASURED, not what is TRUE. A number that
survived its gates on one benchmark is a number about that benchmark.
